what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Chile whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025 there were 662504 people in this group, 11.0% of all Venezuelans in it worldwide.
Only 121 Venezuelans in Chile were counted as refugees that year.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Venezuela.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group in Chile start in 2018 at 285122 and reach 662504 in 2025, their highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025, after a big change between 2018 and 2019.

how.text: These are year-end totals reported to UNHCR, and UNHCR adds notes to some of the figures.
The figures have no breakdown by gender or age.
The sources don't say how people travelled or where in Chile they live.
